title: **Gemini accepts four reasoning levels** — on `google-generative-ai`, pi-ai's Gemini implementation sends only `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, or `high`, compared without case, and fails a request whose `reasoningEfforts` value names anything e...

attrs.text: **Gemini accepts four reasoning levels** — on `google-generative-ai`, pi-ai's Gemini implementation sends only `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, or `high`, compared without case, and fails a request whose `reasoningEfforts` value names anything else; the [Models page](../../client/ui-settings-models/README.md) offers only these levels for such a route. A request without a level, including `off`, sends pi-ai's disabled-thinking configuration, which models that cannot disable thinking, such as Gemini 2.5 Pro, may reject.

title: **Provider HTTP status is unavailable** — pi-ai error events do not expose a stable HTTP status across providers, so failures are classified from the error text. When a message leads with a 4xx or 5xx status, as Anthropic and OpenAI SDK err...

attrs.text: **Provider HTTP status is unavailable** — pi-ai error events do not expose a stable HTTP status across providers, so failures are classified from the error text. When a message leads with a 4xx or 5xx status, as Anthropic and OpenAI SDK errors do, the status rules read only that status. Other formats, such as `Mistral API error (<status>): <body>`, still match a status quoted anywhere in the message, and the quota, rate-limit, and invalid-request wording rules read the whole message, so a gateway 5xx that relays an upstream `insufficient_quota` or `invalid_request_error` becomes a non-retryable `QUOTA` or `INVALID_REQUEST` failure.

title: **Streamed JSON tool-call arguments avoid per-delta reparsing** — the installed pi-ai carries [`patches/@earendil-works__pi-ai@1.3.0.patch`](../../../patches/@earendil-works__pi-ai@1.3.0.patch), which removes the per-delta re-parse of the w...

attrs.text: **Streamed JSON tool-call arguments avoid per-delta reparsing** — the installed pi-ai carries [`patches/@earendil-works__pi-ai@1.3.0.patch`](../../../patches/@earendil-works__pi-ai@1.3.0.patch), which removes the per-delta re-parse of the whole accumulated argument JSON in every stream adapter (upstream [earendil-works/pi#9265](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9265)); unpatched, a multi-megabyte argument stream costs O(n²) CPU on the event loop and stalls every session in the process. Completion events supply parsed arguments; Responses may parse at both argument completion and output-item completion. This adapter reads only delta strings and finalized arguments. Re-apply or retire the patch on every pi-ai upgrade.

title: **Stale Anthropic thinking is omitted even where the endpoint would accept it** — prefix checks depend on the model, the account, and the request, which the adapter cannot observe, so every prefix change and every replay state without `pref...

attrs.text: **Stale Anthropic thinking is omitted even where the endpoint would accept it** — prefix checks depend on the model, the account, and the request, which the adapter cannot observe, so every prefix change and every replay state without `prefixDigest` costs the model that reasoning, and Anthropic regenerates it as output tokens. The digest covers the pi-ai context objects, not the wire body: switching authentication or wire-changing compat settings mid-conversation is not detected, a pi-ai upgrade that changes Anthropic message serialization requires a new `DIGEST_SEED` in [`src/prefix-binding.ts`](src/prefix-binding.ts), and any change to how this package builds those objects drops recorded thinking once.

Models that enforce the check use adaptive thinking in the installed catalog.

Encrypted OpenRouter reasoning details keep their `reasoning_details` replay.

title: **Provider-native discovery answers through this plugin's ambient context** — a route naming no credential defers to the catalog provider's own resolution, which asks for environment values (`AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `AWS_PROFILE`, and each p...

attrs.text: **Provider-native discovery answers through this plugin's ambient context** — a route naming no credential defers to the catalog provider's own resolution, which asks for environment values (`AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `AWS_PROFILE`, and each provider's own set) and for local credential files. Both questions are answered here: the credential seam is consulted before the process environment, and file existence is checked against the host process's filesystem with `~` expanded. What it cannot do is *read* a credential file's contents — a provider that parses `~/.aws/credentials` itself does so directly, outside the seam.

title: **Tool updates require session history** — `GenerateOptions.tools` contains active definitions. `toolHistory` supplies the initial declarations and historically resolved additions from `Session.toolHistory()`. At adapter dispatch, `projectT...

attrs.text: **Tool updates require session history** — `GenerateOptions.tools` contains active definitions. `toolHistory` supplies the initial declarations and historically resolved additions from `Session.toolHistory()`. At adapter dispatch, `projectToolUpdates` constructs deferred declarations and retains removed definitions for `in-history`; `addition-only` omits removed definitions and removal messages. Removing any tool or adding tools to an empty set on an addition-only route rebuilds the baseline from the declarations available after that update. Deferred declarations count as existing tools. Superseded tool blocks are omitted while unrelated content survives; subsequent additions remain deferred. Unsupported routes receive active tools without developer messages or `deferLoading`. Missing history or a request prefix omitting recorded updates falls back to current declarations without developer messages. Explicitly deferred tools become immediate during a rebuild only if an addition has already activated them; unactivated declarations remain deferred.

A header reference that does not match the rebuilt journal cache discards that cache and repeats the original calculation from the beginning.
